name: Veil Cast
description: Throw a sheer veil of false light over a foe so that his target seems to drift and blur.

name: Glamour Jab
description: Jab with a fist dressed in a glamour of an open hand so that the foe lowers his guard to a grab.

name: Mirage Cover
description: Hold a shifting sheet of mirage before the body so that blows land on its far edge and not on the flesh.

name: Decoy Pace
description: Step out of line while a hollow copy of the body takes one more pace in the old direction.

name: Peering Qi
description: Let a thin thread of qi probe a suspect shape and report whether it has weight or only light.

name: Layered Mirage
description: Stack three mirages one behind another so that the foe cannot learn which is the user and blows slide off.

name: Phantom Volley
description: Loose a handful of bright motes of which only some are real so that the foe cannot tell which to dodge.

name: Cloud Gaze
description: Cloud a foe's sight with a milky glamour that thickens the further he looks.

name: Gloss Fist
description: Strike with a fist whose polished glamour throws the foe's reflection into his own eyes.

name: Blurred Guard
description: Raise a drifting haze before the chest that turns every cut aside by a hand's breadth.

name: Haze Slip
description: Slip out of a clinch behind a puff of haze that hides the first stride.

name: Glassy Eye
description: Turn the eye to glass and let qi pass through it to read the edges of any false shape.

name: Flare Mote
description: Flick a mote of false flame near the face of a foe to make him flinch from a harmless spark.

name: Doubled Body
description: Cast a full second body beside the true one and trade places with it as the blow falls.

name: Split Seeming
description: Divide the user's shape into two seemings that move apart so that a foe must choose one to follow.

name: Thin Seeming
description: Spread a thin seeming over the ground ahead so that its slope and distance read wrongly.

name: Pane Strike
description: Strike through a pane of false glass that the foe tries to avoid while the hand passes it.

name: Glass Veil
description: Hang a veil of glassy light at the guard so that a cut skates off its angle and away.

name: Lag Step
description: Move one pace while the image of the body lags one beat behind it.

name: Layered Glamour
description: Lay glamour in thin sheets over the body so that each blow tears one sheet and finds another beneath.

name: Glamour Lift
description: Draw a clinging glamour off an ally's eyes and mind so that he sees his surroundings as they are.

name: Phantasm Seed
description: Flick a seed of qi that blooms into a flash of false shapes as it strikes the target.

name: Phantom Sting
description: Stab with a needle of qi hidden inside the image of a spread hand.

name: Pale Curtain
description: Let fall a pale curtain of light at the guard to blur the line between the body and the air.

name: Spectral Pace
description: Cross the distance in a thin shimmer while a copy walks the longer way round.

name: Image Test
description: Tap a suspected image with a bead of qi and read from the ripple whether it holds weight.

name: Gleam Pull
description: Set a gleam in the corner of a foe's eye that draws his head away from the real threat.

name: Phantasm Lance
description: Throw a lance of qi that looks like smoke until it strikes and drives through a guard.

name: Phantasm Screen
description: Raise a standing screen of lifelike images that takes the blows meant for the user and the allies behind.

name: Rousing Chime
description: Strike a sharp chime of qi at the brow of an ally to wake him from a planted vision.

name: Unseen Palm
description: Drive a palm that the foe's eye slides past so that the first he knows of it is the blow.

name: Gap Veil
description: Cast a veil across the gap between two combatants so that the distance between them seems to change.

name: Vanish Guard
description: Make the guarding forearm vanish from sight and reappear in the path of the blow.

name: Unwitnessed Pace
description: Take a pace that the watcher's eye cannot follow because the moving limb is hidden in light.

name: Seam Finder
description: Trace the faint seam where a glamour joins the true world and mark where it ends.

name: Hand Unseen
description: Strike with a hand drawn out of the foe's sight and leave in its place an image of a still arm.

name: Veiled Grasp
description: Close an unseen hand of qi about a foe's wrist or ankle and hold it fast.

name: Wisp Veil
description: Trail a wisp of pale cloth through the air so that it seems to cover the user's arm.

name: Flicker Fist
description: Throw a fist that flickers between two places so that the foe cannot time his block.

name: Pale Mirror
description: Raise a pale mirror of qi at the elbow to send a thrust away along its smooth face.

name: Dual Pace
description: Pace forward on two overlapping tracks so that the foe sees two walkers and strikes at neither.

name: Keen Glance
description: Flick the eyes across a crowd of figures to pick out those that carry no weight at all.

name: Gleam Snap
description: Snap a point of light before a foe's face to break the rhythm of his guard.

name: Face Shift
description: Shift the features of the face from one look to another so that a watcher doubts his memory.

name: Seeming Sweep
description: Sweep a wave of bright false forms outward that buffets and bewilders every foe within reach.

name: Twin Mirage Guard
description: Hold two mirages of the user at the left and right shoulder to take blows from both sides.

name: Vision Purge
description: Drain the false pictures that cloud an ally's senses until he sees only what is truly before him.

name: Glass Palm
description: Strike with a palm of clear glass light that the foe notices only when it is close.

name: Reflection Turn
description: Turn the body with a copy that reflects the foe's attack back along the line it came.

name: Silver Haze
description: Breathe out a silver haze that glints with false shapes and spoils the foe's reading of range.

name: Reflected Pace
description: Step in the opposite direction to the one the user's reflection seems to take.

name: True Reflection
description: Hold a hand mirror of qi before a shape to see the real form it hides behind its glamour.

name: Shard Flick
description: Flick a shard of bright mirror light from the fingers that cuts like a thrown splinter.

name: Mirror Barrage
description: Fire a rapid spray of mirror shards that each carry an image of the target to confuse the aim of a reply.

name: Mirror Pair
description: Set two mirrors of qi at the forearms to throw a blow of light or force back at its source.
